_comment: What proves a directory is DSH Desktop, in one place: the installer (desktop-bridge/install.mjs) and the plugin's status reader (src/browser-electron/bridge-status.ts) both read this file, and a test asserts neither hard-codes a second copy. A generic Electron layout — resources/app/lib/main.js or resources/app.asar — is NOT proof: any Electron app has that shape.
_layoutNote: resources/app.asar wins over resources/app whenever it exists, so identity is read from the archive in that case and never from the sibling extraction, which the updater leaves behind and which may be a different build.
